name: Saleor
description_en:
Saleor is a headless commerce backend built around GraphQL APIs, an extensible administration dashboard and an application/webhook model. It manages commerce data and operations while the storefront and surrounding services can be built separately.

The project is available as open-source software, and Saleor Cloud is a paid managed-hosting/support offer. A free non-commercial sandbox, self-hosted software and a live Cloud store have different operating and commercial responsibilities.
description_zh:
Saleor 是以 GraphQL API、可扩展管理后台及应用／webhook 模型构建的无头电商后端，管理电商数据和运营，店面及外围服务可独立开发。

项目提供开源软件，Saleor Cloud 则是付费托管支持方案。免费非商业沙盒、自托管软件和正式 Cloud 商店，各有不同运营及商业责任。

core_features.explanation_en: Model products and commerce operations through APIs with a separate storefront.
core_features.explanation_zh: 通过 API 建模商品及电商运营，店面独立。

core_features.explanation_en: Extend administrative UI and connect external services through callbacks and events.
core_features.explanation_zh: 扩展管理界面，并通过回调事件连接外部服务。

sections.title_en: Build a storefront around explicit commerce contracts
sections.title_zh: 围绕明确电商契约构建店面
sections.en: A development team could model product types and variants in Saleor, build a separate storefront and connect payment and fulfilment services. The homepage describes dynamic attributes, GraphQL and synchronous webhook extensions. Test checkout, inventory allocation and external-service failure as one business flow. “Headless” means the presentation is decoupled; it does not supply a finished bespoke storefront or eliminate engineering responsibility.
sections.zh: 开发团队可在 Saleor 建立商品类型和规格，独立开发店面，再连接支付履约。主页介绍动态属性、GraphQL 及同步 webhook 扩展。应把结账、库存分配和外部服务失败作为一条业务流程测试。“无头”表示展示解耦，不会自动提供完成的定制店面，也不会消除工程责任。

sections.title_en: Distinguish source rights from the cost to operate
sections.title_zh: 区分源码权利与运营成本
sections.en: Official documentation describes Saleor as OSI-licensed open source, permits personal/commercial use and private modifications, and references BSD licensing with trademark conditions. It also warns that running servers and maintaining a fork carry costs and upgrade responsibility. This is documentation-level licence research, not a per-component legal audit. Cloud-to-OSS migration is supported in principle but still requires compatible versions and data migration.
sections.zh: 官方文档将 Saleor 描述为采用 OSI 许可的开源项目，允许个人商业使用及私有修改，并提及 BSD 许可和商标条件，同时提示服务器、分叉维护及升级责任仍有成本。这是文档层许可研究，不是逐组件法律审计。Cloud 转 OSS 原则上可行，仍需处理兼容版本和数据迁移。

sections.title_en: Compare a sandbox with commercial Cloud plans
sections.title_zh: 区分沙盒与商业 Cloud 套餐
sections.en: The pricing page marks free Sandboxes for non-commercial use. Select is listed at US$1,599/month with up to US$200,000 monthly GMV and 0.8% on orders exceeding that GMV allowance; Volume is US$3,999 with up to US$1 million and 0.4% excess. Enterprise is negotiated and all plans refer to fair API usage. Confirm billing cadence, GMV definition and applicable overage in a quote; the free sandbox is not a free production-hosting entitlement.
sections.zh: 定价页把免费 Sandboxes 标为非商业用途。Select 列价每月 1,599 美元，含每月最多 200,000 美元 GMV，超出额度订单比例为 0.8%；Volume 为每月 3,999 美元，含 100 万美元 GMV，超额为 0.4%。Enterprise 协商，均提及 API 公平使用。应在报价中确认付款周期、GMV 定义及超额条件；免费沙盒不等于免费生产托管。

sections.title_en: Budget the storefront, apps and operating owner
sections.title_zh: 预算店面、应用和运营负责人
sections.en: Cloud includes described delivery/support services, while optional accelerator and engineering offers have separate upfront charges and conditional credits. Self-hosting moves infrastructure work to the customer; a custom frontend and integrations need their own maintenance either way. Start with product schemas, channel/currency requirements and accountable owners for payment and fulfilment apps. No Cloud provisioning, code installation, checkout or recovery benchmark was performed.
sections.zh: Cloud 描述包含交付支持，另有需先付费、按条件返抵的加速和工程方案。自托管把基础设施工作交给客户；无论哪种方式，自定义前端和集成都需维护。应先准备商品结构、渠道币种需求，以及支付履约应用负责人。本文未开通 Cloud、安装代码、运行结账或测试恢复。

sections.title_en: Choose when an engineering team needs commerce control
sections.title_zh: 适合工程团队需要电商控制权的场景
sections.en: Saleor is relevant to teams building differentiated commerce experiences and willing to own integrations. A merchant expecting a fully finished no-code shop may not want this responsibility; the vendor itself states a builder-oriented fit. Licence freedom is separate from commercial SLA, support, hosting and third-party services, whose exact terms remain unverified.
sections.zh: 需要差异化电商体验且愿意负责集成的团队可评估 Saleor。期待完整即用无代码网店的商家可能不想承担这些责任，厂商本身也强调面向构建团队。许可自由与商业 SLA、支持、托管及第三方服务分开，具体条款仍未核实。
